sources.title: Kusumabaale
sources.author: Devanuru Mahadeva
sources.label: mysuru
sources.copyright: in copyright; short fragments only, private research use

extraction_method: PDF uses a legacy (Nudi-type) font encoding, so the text layer is unusable and no Kannada OCR was available. Kannada was read from page images by the assistant and transcribed manually. Transcription errors are possible.
limitations: All entries are unverified (verification_count 0). No native-speaker check has been done.
Locality is inferred from the author's background, not stated in the text.
Regional_specificity is judged from one text and is not evidence of exclusivity.
Paragraphs file is empty: the source is verse-like and in copyright, so no long excerpts were reproduced.
Standard-class sentences from p.20 are provisional and come from a novel's synopsis, not a formal source.
Only 3 of 172 pages were used; this is a pilot batch.
